text: No, we cannot certify that no fire occurred on this asset during the period. While no thermal anomalies were detected by NASA FIRMS sensors (VIIRS and MODIS) between 2026-10-06 and 2026-11-05, the absence of detections does not guarantee no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not be detected by these sensors. The evidence only confirms that no significant thermal anomalies were observed within the asset boundary during the specified period.
